REGULAR MEETING AGENDA
CERRITOS PLANNING COMMISSION
WEDNESDAY - MARCH 4, 2026 - 07:00 P.M.
CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL CHAMBER
18125 BLOOMFIELD AVENUE, CERRITOS, CA 90703
Agenda Materials
The complete agenda for this meeting is available on-demand at cerritos.gov and at the Community Development Department, 18125 Bloomfield Avenue, 2nd floor, Cerritos, CA, 90703 during regular business hours (Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., weekend and observed holidays excepted). Any materials submitted to the Commission after distribution of this agenda will be available for public inspection at the Community Development Department during regular business hours. Requests for agenda materials or meeting participation assistance can also be made by email to planning@cerritos.gov or by phone at (562) 916-1201 during regular business hours.
Order of Agenda
The Commission, by majority of those members present, may reorder the business items listed on the agenda.
PUBLIC OBSERVATION AND PARTICIPATION
The public can observe the meeting via livestream on the City’s website at cerritos.gov, on cable television at Cerritos TV3, or in person in the Council Chamber.
Public Comments
Members of the public may provide public comment for this meeting in person at the meeting or or in writing as described below.
In-person public comment : Public comment on business agenda items will be opened and may be provided during consideration of that business agenda item. Public comment on Consent Calendar and non-agenda items will be opened and may be provided during Agenda Item No. 4.
Written public comment (hard copy or email) : Public comment may be submitted via email to planning@cerritos.gov or by hard copy to the Community Development Department no later than 3:00 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Please identify the agenda item number in the subject line of the email or hard copy document. All written correspondence received by the 3:00 p.m. deadline will be distributed to the Commission prior to the meeting and retained with the official meeting record.
Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Accommodations
In compliance with the ADA, any person with a disability who requires accommodation in order to participate in a meeting should contact City of Cerritos ADA/504 Coordinator, Drew Schneider, at (562) 916-1314 at least 72 hours prior to the scheduled meeting. The City will use its best efforts to provide reasonable accommodations related to the meeting.
1.

2.

3.

4.
Public Comments and Suggestions
This section is reserved for public comment on Consent Calendar and items not listed on the agenda but that are within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Commission. Verbal comments may be limited to three minutes per speaker, subject to the Chair extending to a maximum of five minutes per speaker, with a total time allotted not to exceed 45 minutes unless the Chair extends.
5.
Consent Calendar
Items listed under the Consent Calendar are considered routine and will be enacted by one motion. Subject to the discretion of the Commission, there will be no separate discussion of these items. If a Commission member requests separate consideration, the item may be removed from the Consent Calendar and considered separately.

CITY OF CERRITOS

  MINUTES

Regular Planning Commission Meeting
March 4, 2026
City Council Chambers
18125 Bloomfield Ave
Cerritos, California 90703

PRESENT:  Commissioner Benjamin Ao
  Commissioner Kiritkumar Chauhan
  Commissioner Riaz Surti
  Vice Chair Deepak “DJ” Jhaveri
  Chair Jose “Armin” Reyes

PRESENT:  Assistant City Attorney Shukan Patel
  Director of Community Development Sabrina Chan
  Assistant City Engineer Jared Lee
  Current Planning Manager Amanda Acuña
  Management Analyst Mariel Angeles
  Senior Planner Jeremy Loh
  Associate Planner Wyman Wong

1.  Call to Order

  The meeting was called to order at 7:00 p.m.

2.  Pledge of Allegiance

  The Pledge of Allegiance was led by Chair Reyes.

3.  Roll Call

  All Members of the Planning Commission were declared present except Commissioner
  Surti, who was noted absent and excused by a majority consensus of the Planning
  Commission.

4.  Public Comments and Suggestions

  Chair Reyes invited comments and suggestions from the public on items not listed on
  the agenda. Seeing and hearing no speakers wishing to address the Planning
  Commission, Chair Reyes closed public comments.

5.  Consent Calendar

5A.  Approval of Minutes

  Wednesday, February 4, 2026, 7:00 p.m. Planning Commission Regular Meeting
  Minutes.

City of Cerritos  March 4, 2026
Planning Commission Meeting Minutes  Page 1
   MOTION: It was moved by Vice Chair Jhaveri, and seconded by Commissioner Ao,
  to approve the Wednesday, February 4, 2026, 7:00 p.m. Planning Commission
  Regular Meeting Minutes.

  The motion carried (4-0-1-0) as follows:

  AYES:  Ao, Chauhan, Jhaveri, Reyes
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  Surti
  ABSTAIN:  None

6.  Public Hearings

6A.  Review and consideration to waive full reading of and adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE
  CERRITOS PLANNING COMMISSION APPROVING PRECISE PLAN 2026-2, A
  PROPOSAL BY THE RESIDENTIAL PROPERTY OWNERS TO CONSTRUCT A FIRST- AND
  SECOND-FLOOR ADDITION TO AN EXISTING SINGLE-STORY RESIDENCE AT 11156
  GONSALVES PLACE, CERRITOS, CALIFORNIA, 90703. THE SUBJECT PROPERTY IS
  ZONED SINGLE-FAMILY RESIDENTIAL (RS-5000) (APN 7049-018-002).*

  *The applicant has also proposed an attached junior accessory dwelling unit (JADU)
  on the subject property. In accordance with state planning and zoning laws, and with
  concurrence by the applicant, the public hearing will not apply to the proposed JADU,
  which will be processed administratively by city staff after completion of review for
  the room addition on the property pursuant to Precise Plan 2026-2.

  *Pursuant to Section 15301 of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA)
  Guidelines, this project is categorically exempt from CEQA review.

  A staff report was given by Senior Planner Jeremy Loh. A PowerPoint presentation
  was displayed, providing details about the proposed project and existing property
  conditions. Mr. Loh continued providing details about the proposed construction of a
  166-square-foot first-floor addition, a new 1,411-square-foot second-floor addition,
  converting the existing 472-square-foot two-car garage into a junior accessory
  dwelling unit (JADU), and a new 546-square-foot attached, two-car garage addition
  to an existing single-story residence on a 5,200-square-foot property. Mr. Loh
  concluded his presentation by stating that no public comments were received
  regarding the proposed project.

  Discussion continued regarding the responsible party as related to parkway trees,
  and clarification between a junior accessory dwelling unit (JADU) and an accessory
  dwelling unit (ADU).

  At 7:28 p.m., Assistant City Attorney Patel announced the arrival of Commissioner
  Surti, noting his attendance at the Planning Commission meeting. Mr. Patel indicated
  that Commissioner Surti was present for the presentation of Precise Plan 2026-2,
  and would be able to consider the item before the Planning Commission.

  Chair Reyes opened the public hearing. Seeing and hearing no speakers wishing to
  address the Planning Commission, Chair Reyes closed public comments.

City of Cerritos  March 4, 2026
Planning Commission Meeting Minutes  Page 2
   MOTION: It was moved by Commissioner Ao and seconded by Commissioner
  Chauhan to waive full reading of and adopt Resolution No. 2026-9: A RESOLUTION
  OF THE CERRITOS PLANNING COMMISSION APPROVING PRECISE PLAN 2026-2, A
  PROPOSAL BY THE RESIDENTIAL PROPERTY OWNERS TO CONSTRUCT A FIRST- AND
  SECOND-FLOOR ADDITION TO AN EXISTING SINGLE-STORY RESIDENCE AT 11156
  GONSALVES PLACE, CERRITOS, CALIFORNIA, 90703. THE SUBJECT PROPERTY IS
  ZONED SINGLE-FAMILY RESIDENTIAL (RS-5000) (APN 7049-018-002).

  The motion carried (5-0) as follows:

  AYES:  Ao, Chauhan, Surti, Jhaveri, Reyes
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

6B.  Review and consideration to waive full reading of and adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE
  CERRITOS PLANNING COMMISSION APPROVING PRECISE PLAN 2026-3, A
  PROPOSAL BY THE RESIDENTIAL PROPERTY OWNERS TO DEMOLISH AN EXISTING
  SINGLE-STORY RESIDENCE AND CONSTRUCT A NEW TWO-STORY RESIDENCE WITH
  AN ATTACHED TWO-CAR GARAGE AT 19310 ALLINGHAM AVENUE, CERRITOS,
  CALIFORNIA, 90703. THE SUBJECT PROPERTY IS ZONED SINGLE-FAMILY
  RESIDENTIAL (RS-5000) (APN 7049-010-020).*

  *Pursuant to Section 15301 of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA)
  Guidelines, this project is categorically exempt from CEQA review.

  A staff report was given by Associate Planner Wyman Wong. A PowerPoint
  presentation was displayed, providing details about the proposed project and existing
  property conditions. Mr. Wong continued his presentation, providing details about the
  proposed demolition of the existing single-story residence, patio structures, a shed,
  and espaliers, and the construction of a new two-story residence with an attached
  two-car garage on a 5,901-square-foot property.

  Discussion continued regarding the current existing property conditions, specifically
  artificial turf and rocks in the front yard setback.

  Chair Reyes opened the public hearing. Seeing and hearing no speakers wishing to
  address the Planning Commission, Chair Reyes closed public comments.

  MOTION: It was moved by Commissioner Chauhan and seconded by Vice Chair
  Jhaveri to waive full reading of and adopt Resolution No. 2026-10: A RESOLUTION
  OF THE CERRITOS PLANNING COMMISSION APPROVING PRECISE PLAN 2026-3, A
  PROPOSAL BY THE RESIDENTIAL PROPERTY OWNERS TO DEMOLISH AN EXISTING
  SINGLE-STORY RESIDENCE AND CONSTRUCT A NEW TWO-STORY RESIDENCE WITH
  AN ATTACHED TWO-CAR GARAGE AT 19310 ALLINGHAM AVENUE, CERRITOS,
  CALIFORNIA, 90703. THE SUBJECT PROPERTY IS ZONED SINGLE-FAMILY
  RESIDENTIAL (RS-5000) (APN 7049-010-020).

City of Cerritos  March 4, 2026
Planning Commission Meeting Minutes  Page 3
   The motion carried (5-0) as follows:

  AYES:  Ao, Chauhan, Surti, Jhaveri, Reyes
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

6C.  Review and consideration to waive full reading of and adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE
  CERRITOS PLANNING COMMISSION APPROVING PRECISE PLAN 2024-4(A)(2026)
  AMENDMENT, REGARDING MODIFICATIONS TO PREVIOUSLY APPROVED PRECISE
  PLAN 2024-4, A PROPOSAL BY THE RESIDENTIAL PROPERTY OWNERS TO DEMOLISH
  AN EXISTING ONE-STORY RESIDENCE AND CONSTRUCT A NEW TWO-STORY
  RESIDENCE AT 19211 BECHARD AVENUE, CERRITOS, CALIFORNIA 90703. THE
  SUBJECT PROPERTY IS ZONED SINGLE-FAMILY RESIDENTIAL (RS-6500) (APN 7044-
  001-023).*

  *Pursuant to Section 15301 of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA)
  Guidelines, this project is categorically exempt from CEQA review.

  A staff report was given by Senior Planner Jeremy Loh. A PowerPoint presentation
  was displayed, providing details about the proposed project and existing property
  conditions. Mr. Loh began his presentation by providing details on the previously
  approved Precise Plan 2024-4 to demolish an existing single-story residence and to
  construct a new two-story residence, with a three-car garage and attached accessory
  dwelling unit (ADU), on an 11,880-square-foot property. Mr. Loh informed the
  Commission that, following the Planning Commission’s approval, building permits for
  the project were issued in July and construction began. The property owners are now
  requesting approval of an amendment to Precise Plan 2024-4 to add a 122-square-
  foot bathroom on the second floor and to expand the second-floor balcony by 243
  square feet, thereby proposing a minor modification to the previously approved
  Precise Plan.

  Discussion continued regarding the proposed ADU, including parking requirements,
  maximum occupancy, and property tax assessments.

  Chair Reyes opened the public hearing. Seeing and hearing no speakers wishing to
  address the Planning Commission, Chair Reyes closed public comments.

  MOTION: It was moved by Vice Chair Jhaveri and seconded by Commissioner Ao to
  waive full reading of and adopt Resolution No. 2026-11: A RESOLUTION OF THE
  CERRITOS PLANNING COMMISSION APPROVING PRECISE PLAN 2024-4(A)(2026)
  AMENDMENT, REGARDING MODIFICATIONS TO PREVIOUSLY APPROVED PRECISE
  PLAN 2024-4, A PROPOSAL BY THE RESIDENTIAL PROPERTY OWNERS TO DEMOLISH
  AN EXISTING ONE-STORY RESIDENCE AND CONSTRUCT A NEW TWO-STORY
  RESIDENCE AT 19211 BECHARD AVENUE, CERRITOS, CALIFORNIA 90703. THE
  SUBJECT PROPERTY IS ZONED SINGLE-FAMILY RESIDENTIAL (RS-6500) (APN 7044-
  001-023).

City of Cerritos  March 4, 2026
Planning Commission Meeting Minutes  Page 4
   The motion carried (5-0) as follows:

  AYES:  Ao, Chauhan, Surti, Jhaveri, Reyes
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

6D.  Review and consideration to waive full reading of and adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE
  CERRITOS PLANNING COMMISSION RECOMMENDING THAT THE CERRITOS CITY
  COUNCIL APPROVE DEVELOPMENT CODE AMENDMENT 2026-2, A REQUEST TO
  AMEND TITLE 5 AND TITLE 22 OF THE CERRITOS MUNICIPAL CODE BY AMENDING
  CHAPTER 5.35 AND ADDING SECTION 22.40.340 TO PROHIBIT THE SALE,
  DISTRIBUTION, POSSESSION, AND CONSUMPTION OF NITROUS OXIDE IN THE
  CITY OF CERRITOS.*

  *Pursuant to Section 15061(b)(3) of the California Environmental Quality Act
  (CEQA), this project is categorically exempt from CEQA review.

  A staff report was given by Management Analyst Mariel Angeles. A PowerPoint
  presentation was displayed, providing details on the City Council's direction related
  to the regulation of nitrous oxide in the City. Ms. Angeles continued her presentation
  by providing details on State Legislation addressing the misuse of nitrous oxide,
  legislation adopted by other jurisdictions, staff analysis, and exemptions proposed
  for legal use of nitrous oxide under DCA 2026-2. The proposed Development Code
  Amendment 2026-2 (DCA 2026-2) to amend Title 5 and Title 22 of the Cerritos
  Municipal Code would prohibit the sale, distribution, possession, and consumption of
  nitrous oxide for recreational purposes in the City of Cerritos.

  Discussion continued regarding the number of tobacco retailer licenses in the City,
  nitrous oxide misuse incidences in the City, and the exemptions for legal use of
  nitrous oxide under DCA 2026-2.

  Chair Reyes opened the public hearing. Seeing and hearing no speakers wishing to
  address the Planning Commission, Chair Reyes closed public comments.

  MOTION: It was moved by Vice Chair Jhaveri and seconded by Commissioner Ao to
  waive full reading of and adopt Resolution No. 2026-12: A RESOLUTION OF THE
  CERRITOS PLANNING COMMISSION RECOMMENDING THAT THE CERRITOS CITY
  COUNCIL APPROVE DEVELOPMENT CODE AMENDMENT 2026-2, A REQUEST TO
  AMEND TITLE 5 AND TITLE 22 OF THE CERRITOS MUNICIPAL CODE BY AMENDING
  CHAPTER 5.35 AND ADDING SECTION 22.40.340 TO PROHIBIT THE SALE,
  DISTRIBUTION, POSSESSION, AND CONSUMPTION OF NITROUS OXIDE IN THE CITY
  OF CERRITOS.

  The motion carried (5-0) as follows:

  AYES:  Ao, Chauhan, Surti, Jhaveri, Reyes
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

City of Cerritos  March 4, 2026
Planning Commission Meeting Minutes  Page 5
 7.  Reports

7A.  Reports from Designated Commission Liaison

  Current Planning Manager Amanda Acuña reported that one (1) written public
  comment was received under Agenda Item 4A. The comment was provided to the
  Commission and members of the public at the meeting, and was read into the
  record.
7B.  Reports from Planning Commission Members

  Reports were given by Commissioner Chauhan and Chair Reyes.

8.  Adjournment

  The meeting adjourned at 8:30 p.m.
